description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 07.05.2018 to 13.05.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically governing how foreign currency conversions will be handled for customs purposes. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters, as it is a statutory instrument that modifies how existing laws (the Customs Ordinance) are applied and rescinds a previous notification.
